VBO:0200369.summary: The Cockalier brings together Cavalier King Charles Spaniel and Cocker Spaniel ancestry, but the Cocker side may be English or American. Breeding programs use both first crosses and later matings between these lines, so the name does not specify one fixed combination. Individuals differ in build and coat, and the cross label alone does not establish temperament.
VBO:0200369.shortDescription: A Cavalier–Cocker cross whose Cocker ancestry may be English or American, with first crosses and later generations.

sources.title: Orders of St John Care Trust — Watson at Grace Care Centre (August 2022)
sources.evidence: Personally read complete actual operator article. Exact Cockalier explicitly Cavalier King Charles Spaniel–Cocker Spaniel. Watson was six months old and brought to care home by owner/head of dementia care; intended PAT role is not proof of certification. Only actual named visiting role proposed, not juvenile behavior generalized to adult Cockaliers, breed-wide child safety, clinical effect or therapy aptitude.

sources.title: Northern News Now — original Lars report (April 30, 2026)
sources.evidence: Personally read complete actual original local report body, owner interview and date. Lars explicitly three-year-old Cockalier, Cocker Spaniel–Cavalier King Charles cross, visiting Essentia hospital rooms once weekly with owner. This original interview is primary reporting of individual role, not population behavior or efficacy study. No quote or clinical benefit transferred; ambiguous handler duration versus dog age excluded.

sources.title: Essentia Health — native therapy animal program and Lars roster
sources.evidence: Personally read complete actual hospital program, FAQs and named roster. Lists Lars but does not independently name breed; program context supplements original interview only. No inferred certification organization, medical benefit, universal visiting duration, safety or suitability promise. No hospital/news photography acquired or used.

sources.title: Cottage Canines Australia — Cockalier breeding definition
sources.evidence: Independently read substantive page 2026-10-06, especially definition paragraphs: English or American Cocker, Cavalier, and already-crossbred parents are used. No particular cross standard; varied build/coat. Parent-derived temperament, hybrid-vigour, nonaggression and child-suitability marketing excluded. Purina Cockalier article independently corroborates varied Cocker ancestry and generations but its parent-averaged character is not adopted.
